BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Donaghy, Bronoske, Stonier, Riccelli, Fosse, and Ormsby
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Extending the expiration date of the ambulance transport fund.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to extending the expiration date of the ambulance transport fund; amending RCW 74.70.901; and providing an expiration date.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 74.70.901 and 2020 c 354 s 13 are each amended to read as follows:Expiration date—2020 c 354.
